history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's ES-FL Fix details. This function is used to fix the ES / FL movement for a selected booking, by selecting and updating the correct booking of the selected container.
features: This function is used to fix the ES / FL movement for the selected bookings. The screen shows the selected booking's linked container movements of ES and FL, with the linked booking number, move date and Pickup & Turn in reference details. Here the user can select and update the correct booking for the selected container.

events.description: Swap: switches Voyage between the auto populate field and the Select Voyage Port drop down list
events.triggered_when: User clicks the swap icon beside Voyage

events.description: Search: queries the data based on the entered query fields and shows it in the data grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks Search after entering at least one query field

events.description: Reset: clears all the query fields to query with new data
Update Gate Out / Gate In: selects the movement (Gate Out Move - ES / Gate In Move - FL) to be fixed for the record
events.triggered_when: User selects Gate Out or Gate In on the queried record

events.description: Submit: fixes the selected ES / FL movement for the selected booking
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after selecting Gate Out or Gate In
